**Valmont depot handover**

Established: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, 410 average daily departures, 530 winter peak, 1.8% cancellations. Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028. Ops lead: Halvard Onstad. Night supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic. Parts store: 1100 line items; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim.

Failed/fixed: Feb 2025 brake line failure grounded 9 vehicles 4 days; cause unestablished. Sept 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4200.

Planned: electrification study approved, unfunded; second charging bay Q3.

Open: night shift understaffed; old ticketing terminal on 3 routes; winter peak capacity unmodelled; May 2026 double roster left 2 shifts uncovered.

Rules: brake check every 6000km; fuel card second approval above €200; part above €500 needs two quotations; route change needs 7 days' notice; incident report within 24 hours; roster needs single named publisher; driver training 11 days, curriculum revised April 2026.
